requirements.value: Full unmodified ClawHub lbs-amap 1.1.1 ZIP (36 files, all 33 referenced docs including references/security.md); SHA-256 9468743ee18dbe1704e8a98f47f6628d6a4e6acec30a05f0b8f59a07603d011f. SKILL.md is at ZIP root; no source.path is needed.

Supply your own AMap Web JSAPI Key and securityJsCode, or a correctly configured backend serviceHost proxy. Keep sensitive values in private host configuration; production must not expose security credentials. AMap account authorization, allowed domains, quotas, usage terms and possible billing are separate.

License declaration discrepancy is preserved: SKILL.md declares MIT; skill-card.md and ClawHub metadata declare MIT-0. There is no standalone LICENSE.
